shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc "cat package.json app/UserDashboard.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json && rg -n 'async|fetch\\(|cookies\\(|headers\\(|no-store|revalidate|UserDashboard' app . --glob '"'!package-lock.json'"' --glob '"'!pnpm-lock.yaml'"' --glob '"'!yarn.lock'"' --glob '"'!node_modules/**'"' --glob '"'!.git/**'"'"
/bin/bash -lc 'cat app/page.tsx app/layout.tsx .gitignore && git status --short && for file in /AGENTS.md /workspace/AGENTS.md; do if [ -f "$file" ]; then cat "$file"; fi; done'

/bin/bash -lc "git restore -- tsconfig.json && python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import shutil
import tempfile

artifacts = Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix='dashboard-build-'))
for name in ('.next', 'next-env.d.ts'):
    shutil.move(str(Path(name)), str(artifacts / name))
PY

git diff --check && git status --short"
